Attached: 1 image

Rental applications often want one PDF: the ID page, the signed last page of the old lease and two pages of a bank statement. Not three attachments with 40 pages in them.

In myPDF, Merge lets you pick the pages you need from each file before it joins them, so nothing extra goes out. It's part of Pro, a one-time purchase with no subscription.
